verses.1: And Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, “Be careful to obey all the commandments that I command you today.”
verses.2: And it shall be on the day that you cross the Jordan into the land that Jehovah your God gives you. Then you will see huge stones laid there, and you will use your arms to move those stones.
verses.3: And you shall write on them all the words of this Torah, so that when you enter the land that Jehovah your God gives you, you may have a land full of milk and honey, just as Jehovah, your God, has spoken about it to your ancestors.
verses.4: And when you crossed the Jordan, you should build these stones. These are the stones that I command you to build today on Mount Ebal. You must also take them and use them as a monument.
verses.5: And you built there a statue for Yahweh your God. It was a statue made of stones; do not place silver on it.
verses.6: I will build an altar for the worship of Jehovah your God. I will place upon it the offerings that you shall offer to Jehovah your God.
verses.7: And you sacrificed sacrifices, and you ate there. You also celebrated in front of Yahweh, your God.
verses.8: And you wrote on the stones all the words of this Torah.
verses.9: Moses and the priests spoke to all of Israel, saying, “Behold, today you will become a people of the LORD your God.” And Israel heard these words that day: “Today you will become a people of the LORD your God.”
verses.10: And you have heard the voice of the LORD your God. You have obeyed His commands and laws, which I have given you today.
verses.11: And Moses commanded the people on that day, “Be careful!”
verses.12: These will stand to bless the people on Mount Gerizim, as they cross the Jordan River. They will also bless Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin.
verses.13: And these will stand on the mountain of Ebal, along with Reuben, Gad, and Asher, and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
verses.14: And the Levites answered, and said to all the people of Israel, “With a loud voice!”
verses.15: Let the man who makes idols and graven images be punished by Jehovah. It is the work of a wicked person. Let him be hidden in secrecy. All the people answered, “Yes!”
verses.16: Aruur Makleh’s father and mother also swore an oath. And all the people also swore an oath.
verses.17: Aruur Masisig crossed his boundary, and all the people swore an oath.
verses.18: “Arur Mashgeh was in the wilderness, and all the people said, ‘Amen.’”
verses.19: Aruur Meteh said that Ger-Yatom and Almana were guilty of wrongdoing. And all the people swore an oath to this.
verses.20: Aruur lay with his father’s wife, because she had pierced her father’s breast. And all the people said, “Truly.”
verses.21: Aruur lies with all the animals, and all the people said, “Yes!”
verses.22: And they lay with their sister, either the daughter of their father or the daughter of their mother. And all the people said, “Yes.”
verses.23: And he lay down with his father, and all the people swore an oath.
verses.24: Aruur maqeh re’ehu ba’sateer, and said, “All the people swear an oath.”
verses.25: They decided to take a bloodless person’s life. And all the people swore an oath.
verses.26: Let those who do not keep the words of this Torah to their own credit. And let all the people say, “Amen.”
